quest.title: A Teapot to Call Home: Part I
quest.description: The crisis looming over Liyue Harbor has calmed, and it's business as usual in the city. However, Madame Ping, the flower-admirer from Yujing Terrace, seems to have something more to discuss with you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Serenitea Pot x1, Unknown Item #370304 x1, Tianyuan Lantern: Fragrant Brilliance x1, Profitable Fruit Stand x1

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Ah, children, come, come! Haha, you've arrived at just the right moment. I've been looking for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, what is it, Granny? Need any help?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Oh, no, no. You've done so much for Liyue Harbor already. I could hardly ask for more.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: In fact, my old friends and I have been putting our heads together to think of what sort of gift we might give you in return.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A gift? For Paimon!?

choices.text: I only did as I should.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Haha, oh, child. You are so very modest — uncommonly so, even. But you mustn't decline this gift, I simply won't allow it.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: When you traversed my old teapot in search of the Cleansing Bell, I heard your little friend mention that you often camp out in the wilds...

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: That simply won't do — especially since, I imagine, you still have a very long journey ahead of you.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Fortunately, I have not yet grown so old as to see my Sub-Space Creation abilities atrophy...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...What's Sub-Space Creation?

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Oh? Did my friends never mention that to you? Well then. It is a blessing we old folks once received from Rex Lapis — part of our "illumination," if you will.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: I will not go into too much detail, but Sub-Space Creation is the ability to create a small, autonomous pocket world.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: The teapot that you entered previously was a little trinket created using that ability.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A "trinket," you say...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, in the eyes of an adeptus, creating a magic teapot world is just child's play, huh?

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Indeed, the teapot is nothing to boast of. One such as myself must depart from this realm to create a world of one's own. Rex Lapis, on the other hand, moved mountains and seas... That is what one might call an exercise of true power.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: But that's enough nostalgia for now. The gift that I have prepared for you just requires a few final materials to add the finishing touch...

choices.text: What are the missing materials?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! Finding stuff's what we're good at, after all!

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Ho ho! Settle down now, children, there is no need for you to go running hither and thither... I have already found a fleet-footed youngster to prepare what I need.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: What's more, I doubt that you would know how to find the materials I am searching for. Some of them are very rare indeed these days...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And what are those, if I might ask?

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Well... For starters, I require some Shimmersoil from the banks of Dihua Marsh. Back in the day, it could only be found where the Glaze Lilies thrived most profusely.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: You would have to dig downward, following the roots of the Glaze Lilies, and if you were lucky enough, you just might find a small patch of Shimmersoil there.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: *sigh* But almost no one has been able to find Shimmersoil in this manner since Dihua Marsh came to be the way it is today.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Even more difficult to find is Smaragdus Jadeite, which must be chiseled from the rock of The Chasm. Or so it used to be — ever since the Blackcliff Forge opened for business, they've slowly but surely stripped the mines all but completely bare of it.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: In any case, Smaragdus Jadeite is an adepti treasure, and the adeptal power within is not something that most humans can withstand. Extended contact with it is, in fact, harmful to humans.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: *sigh* Goodness knows if that child will succeed in finding these items...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Who's this "child"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, since you're an adeptus, Granny, the person you asked for help... they must be an adeptus too, right?

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Hmm... Yes, I suppose she does count as an adeptus.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She... "counts"? ...How come there are so many adepti in Liyue Harbor? We seem to bump into them all the time. It feels like even when you go out to eat, you could be sitting next to an adeptus and never even know it...

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Ho ho, maybe so, who can say. A fair few of my old friends are rather fond of mundane, mortal life, after all.
I'm back, Granny.
Oh, I don't believe we've met...

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Ah, allow me to do the honors. This child here is Yanfei. She's the one helping run some errands for me.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: #Yanfei, I believe you've already heard of the Traveler and {M#his}{F#her} traveling companion.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Of course, who hasn't! Much has been written about you in the Millelith's records.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: You became one of Liyue's most wanted after the Millelith marked you as a suspect following the incident at the Rite of Descension, after which you fought off the Millelith at Jueyun Karst and made contact with the Fatui...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Before finally defeating an ancient god together with Granny and her associates, and subsequently being cleared of any and all suspicion by the Qixing... Ah, what a shame...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...A shame?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: A shame that we didn't meet sooner.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: If we had... Well, I can't say that I would've been able to clear you of suspicion immediately — but it certainly would have been less, ah, embarrassing for you.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Allow me to introduce myself once more. I'm Yanfei, a legal adviser. Got a legal problem? You can come right to me!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Oh yes, here's my business card. You'll find it has my contact details and office address. Keep it handy!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: If you have an urgent issue, just leave me a note at this address. Oh, and I almost forgot to mention — I offer a very generous discount for first-time customers...

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Alright, Yanfei, alright. Let's get to the business at hand — I do not think that these two are in any dire need of legal assistance at the moment.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: You'll have to excuse Yanfei. She's always been like this, ever the talkative one when it comes to her own affairs.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you... really an adeptus?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon was gonna ask the same question! You seem really different from the ones we've met before.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: An adeptus? Uh, I guess... kinda? My old man said he was one, anyway.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: He mentioned that he once campaigned with Rex Lapis for a long old time, and after that was all over, he went back and married my mom.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: They had me, and once I was all grown up, the two of them upped and left on a journey, leaving me with Granny here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Um, okay...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's a bit casual for an adeptus! Aren't you guys supposed to sign solemn contracts to protect Liyue Harbor and all that stuff? What do you mean, he just went back to get married?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Well, my dad did say that he'd talked it through with Rex Lapis and that he was fine with it. Even contributed towards the wedding gift, apparently.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Anyway, let's not dwell on that too much. So, Granny, I've gotten ahold of most of the stuff you asked for. Except for... Smaragdus Jadeite. I couldn't find any at all.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: The Chasm's been sealed off, and there's just no way in. Couldn't secure any documentation either. Looks like the Ministry of Civil Affairs is serious about keeping it strictly locked down.

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Is that so? Hmm... But Smaragdus Jadeite is really rather essential...

response.speaker: Madame Ping
response.text: Yanfei, are you sure you can't find some other way? They have helped Liyue greatly, after all. It is only right that they are duly rewarded.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I know, Granny, you've told me a thousand times already. Well, The Chasm's definitely a no-go, but there's still a chance we can figure out some alternative means of procurement...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Hmm, hold on a moment. Let me have a look...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, that's a really thick book. What kind of things do you write in there...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Commercial consultancy... ore... ore... Snezhnaya... Ah, found him.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Krosl</color>, a Snezhnayan merchant who once came to me with some legal queries on certain articles in the legal codices. If my memory serves, all of them had to do with rare ores.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: He mentioned that he was considering acquiring some <color=#00E1FFFF>Smaragdus Jadeite</color> to make hairpins, and wanted to know if there were any legal ramifications that he should be aware of... Said he was planning to sell them in Snezhnaya.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: So, I guess I'll go look for him. With any luck, he'll have gotten his hands on some Smaragdus Jadeite, or might have an idea of where we can find some.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We'll come with you.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Oh, you want to join me? ...I suppose that's no problem, but it's best if you just stand by and watch. If you try to get involved, you'll only risk placing yourself in legal jeopardy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, an adeptus imploring us to avoid incurring legal liability... That's a first for sure...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Best we be a little more careful than usual while we're with her...

choices.text: I can help you look for them!
You're too kind...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Hello there, Mr. Krosl. How's business been?

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: Oh, good, very good. All thanks to your advice, Miss Yanfei. What brings you here today?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: You're too kind, I was simply doing my job. Now, I believe that the last time we met, you mentioned that you were looking to source some Smaragdus Jadeite to make hairpins. Have there been any further developments on this front?

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: Oh, I... uh... Well, yes, as a matter of fact, in the end, I did acquire a small piece of Smaragdus Jadeite and had it fashioned into a pair of hairpins.

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: Miss Yanfei... might I presume that you have an interest in the hairpins? I must apologize, I have already rented them out to a lady named <color=#00E1FFFF>Zhiqiao</color>... If you'd like to inspect them, you may have to wait quite some time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, isn't Smaragdus Jadeite really rare? Aren't you worried about the hairpins getting damaged or lost while they're being rented out?

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: No, I'm not worried in the slightest, because I signed a contract with Ms. Zhiqiao before renting them to her.

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: The contract makes it quite clear that if she loses or damages the item in question, she must compensate me for its full original value.

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: In return, I included a clause that guarantees the Smaragdus Jadeite is genuine, with a penalty of ten times the item's value payable by me to Ms. Zhiqiao in the event that it is shown to be a fake.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No ambiguities there.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Guaranteed genuine, with ten times the value payable if this claim is shown to be false... Yes, these terms are very clear indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: Of course. This way, both the client and I have the assurance we need. To ensure fairness, each of us has retained an original copy of the contract.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: In that case, might you know where Ms. Zhiqiao lives? We'd like to pay her a visit and have a look at the hairpins.

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: Oh, of course. She wrote her address down when we signed our contract. Here, I'll mark it on your map for you.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Thanks a lot, Mr. Krosl. We'll be off now.
Oh... Whatever shall I do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, are you Zhiqiao?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: Y—Yes, that's me. Is there something I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: How do you do, Ms. Zhiqiao? We understand from Mr. Krosl that you recently rented a pair of hairpins from him.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: My associates and I are very interested in them. Would you mind letting us take a look at them?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: The hairpins... I can't lend them to you right now... I—I've lost them.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: I don't know how it could have happened. I always kept them right by my side, and I hadn't even worn them yet...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: I spent so much money on them... If I have to pay their original value... Th—There's no way I could come up with that amount of money on such short notice.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why did you need them in the first place?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: I... My family is in the ore business, too. But business has been suffering ever since The Chasm was sealed off.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: We now have a backlog of paid-up orders just sitting around, so we've been having to purchase some stock from other ore merchants to complete them.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: A big banquet is coming up in a few days, and several ore merchants I know of will be there. I need this opportunity to mingle and discuss prices.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: That's what the hairpins were for, to... Well, to keep up appearances. I can't have them looking down on me.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: But now that I've lost the hairpins... What will I do...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... why does Paimon have a sudden strong sense of déjà vu...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe because this is the part where we say, "we can help"?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: W—Would you really? I sent a commission to the Adventurers' Guild, but I haven't heard anything back from them yet.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Hold on, don't run off looking for the hairpins just yet. Ms. Zhiqiao, would you let me have a look at the rental contract you signed?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: Huh? Well, I mean, sure, I have it right here. Here you are.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Let me see. Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right, Yanfei said she's a legal adviser, didn't she? Maybe she can help Zhiqiao somehow?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That would be a little unfair to Krosl.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: True... Though, surely there must be a win-win solution?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Right, I've finished reading the contract. The terms are very clear, and they do indeed stipulate that you must pay Mr. Krosl the original value of the hairpins as compensation for the loss.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Furthermore, the contract also expressly states that the amount of compensation must take current market prices into account...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: And given the rarity of Smaragdus Jadeite, I fear that the final amount of compensation may end up being significantly higher as a result...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: Even higher!? Oh no...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-oh, Zhiqiao looks like she's about to faint...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: ...However, all of this is assuming that it is indeed genuine Smaragdus Jadeite that was inlaid into the hairpins.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you really have to pause before saying that part? ...Anyway, the hairpins are lost, so how exactly would we be able to find out if the jadeite is genuine or not?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whichever way you look at it, we've gotta start by finding those hairpins.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Except that if we found the hairpins, there'd no longer be any need to check whether the jadeite is genuine, would there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... seems right...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: Please... Please, I... Don't trouble yourselves over this. The fact is, I lost the item and I should pay compensation per the contract...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's such a huge sum of money, though...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: However much it is, I will have to pay it... My family are merchants, after all. It's vital that we keep our word and respect our contracts.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: Now that it's come to this, I really shouldn't keep Krosl in the dark any longer. I'll go and inform him of the issue, and then... negotiate the amount of compensation.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Mm, yes, legally speaking, it seems this is the most sensible course of action. But before that, I have some questions about the hairpins.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: So hold on a moment, Ms. Zhiqiao. When you first touched the hairpins, what did you feel?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: What did I feel? Well, I remember that the gemstones set into the pins were perfectly smooth to the touch, like the finest-quality jade...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: My family has seen much jade pass through its hands in the past, so I am quite certain of my judgment in this matter.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Smooth to the touch... finest-quality jade...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: No, it's nothing. I just need to re-examine a few things. Let's head over to <color=#00E1FFFF>Mr. Krosl's</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: Ah, Miss Yanfei, you've returned... with Ms. Zhiqiao in tow too, I see. How are the hairpins? I trust you're quite satisfied with them?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: Ahem, about that...

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: ...You lost them!? Are you serious? Do you have any idea how expensive they were!?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I'm sorry! Truly, I am... I'll pay the compensation as per our contract, every last Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: Mora? Hmph! Do you have any idea what I had to go through to get my hands on that Smaragdus Jadeite!?

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: I... I just don't... Hmph, forget it. Talking won't bring them back. Since Miss Yanfei is here, I suppose we can just have her estimate the amount that needs to be paid.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: No problem. But before I can give an official estimate, I'll need to do a little market research. Ah, yes, and if I may just confirm again...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: It was in fact genuine Smaragdus Jadeite inlaid into the hairpins, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: Of course! Genuine article, guaranteed, or I pay back ten times the value!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Alright, understood. I'll conduct some market research, and once I'm back, I'll provide an official assessment of the sum owed by Ms. Zhiqiao in compensation. Please wait here, Mr. Krosl.

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: Thank you very much. Hmph, how could she lose my hairpins... She'd better pay every last Mora that they're worth!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: Looks like I'll have to find some way to raise that money...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Please wait, Ms. Zhiqiao. I have something to discuss with you.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: It's not convenient to speak here, so... Let's find somewhere that <color=#00E1FFFF>we can sit</color> and talk in more detail.

talks.objective: Find a convenient place to talk to Zhiqiao

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can think of someone who would definitely disagree with your reasoning...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think there is more than just "reason" involved here, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Well, since we've got what we came for, it's time to pay <color=#00E1FFFF>Granny</color> a visit. I'll bet she's been on tenterhooks for a while now.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: Miss Yanfei, what is this about? Are you... Are you here to tell me how much I owe?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: No. What I wanted to talk about is: There is a chance that the ore inlaid on those hairpins may not be Smaragdus Jadeite after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not Smaragdus Jadeite? Really?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What do you mean? Are you implying that you already sneaked off and found them?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Obviously not. I'm no adventurer, let alone a member of the Guild. I don't run thankless, time-consuming errands for a living. Let's just say... I made some deductions.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I don't know if Granny told you this, but Smaragdus Jadeite is found deep underground and contains very concentrated elemental energy.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: If mere mortals come into contact with it, well, they'll be sick in the best case, and in the worst-case, they could even experience a dramatic change of personality. It most certainly would not be "smooth to the touch."

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Ms. Zhiqiao, did you, at any time, feel unwell while the hairpins were in your possession?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: No, not at all. I felt perfectly fine the whole time, not even the slightest bit unwell. I didn't feel anything special at all, in fact...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Hmm... Now that is strange. I noticed earlier that there were elemental traces in Mr. Krosl's vicinity.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: If I have deduced correctly, he may still have the Smaragdus Jadeite in his possession.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If that's the case, we should go confront him right now and expose his dirty scam right to his face!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Absolutely not. If we were to confront him now, there's no way he would admit to it. Eventually, he would find some argument to compel us to leave...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: And then he'd throw the Smaragdus Jadeite into the sea the moment we were gone...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: After that, he would simply insist that Ms. Zhiqiao pay up, per the contract. He would lose nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Meanwhile, we would have to look under every stone in Liyue, hoping and praying that the hairpins do actually still exist somewhere in this world...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A very vivid description...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So vivid that Paimon thinks it might be experience talking.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Oh, it certainly is. I've seen my fair share of situations like this, and brute-force methods are certainly one way of resolving them... Fortunately, I have far more elegant solutions at my disposal. I'll share them with you in due course.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: W—Well then, since you're so experienced in dealing with problems like this... Perhaps you could help me, Ms. Yanfei?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Oh, that won't be a problem... But first, Ms. Zhiqiao, could I ask you to please sign this contract?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Huh? Does there have to be a contract for everything? Paimon can't even keep track.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If I had one Mora for every time I hear the word "contract"...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It feels like Yanfei is even more concerned with them than a certain someone else we know.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: These are my formal Terms of Engagement. Everything prior to now has just been pro-bono advice, but for me to investigate any further, I require a written contract.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Any work commissioned but not bound by a contract cannot be relied upon.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: I understand. Then I will be glad to place this matter into your capable hands if you will take it, Miss Yanfei.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: No problem! Just sign here, and I'll sign too... Okay... Now, write your address here, and then sign on this page as well...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: And I'll also need your signatures on pages five, seven, and on the very last page. Finally, if you could just use this ink pad to make a handprint over here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* This contract has so many pages... Paimon's all out of brain juice again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Such an ordeal.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Alright, that should do it. My fees are the same as always, and they're written in the contract. Have a look through and let me know if you have any questions.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: I've had a read through. Everything checks out.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Well then, here's your copy of the contract. I will retain the other copy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Need me to do anything?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Not for now, no. Despite how intractable this problem might sound, it will actually be quite straightforward to resolve — once we've got some things squared away.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I don't believe you've been part of an investigation like this before — in which case, hopefully, this should be quite the experience.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: Miss Yanfei, I have to ask... Why are you helping me?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Because, as it happens, I'm currently trying to acquire some Smaragdus Jadeite myself. I noticed strong traces of Geo energy around Mr. Krosl, so perhaps he has, in fact, secured some.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Whether he actually made it into an item of jewelry or not is a separate matter... But either way, it's a lead. As long as we follow it... who knows? We might just be able to get our hands on some Smaragdus Jadeite.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Also... The idea of someone abusing the law to their advantage... I won't stand for it.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: But again, let's not dwell on this. Let's go to, hmm... Where can we find someone who processes ore...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Ah, I've got it. Let's pay a visit to <color=#00E1FFFF>Shitou</color>, the boss of The Jade Mystery. He's a professional when it comes to working with stone and ore.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: If Mr. Krosl had his ore worked on at all, Shitou would undoubtedly have been his first choice.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Why, hello there, honored customers. Welcome to— Oh, it's you, Miss Yanfei. Is... something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: S—Surely not more spurious claims that my jade betting is rigged and no one can ever win? Oh, I swear on all that is sacred...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: No, nothing of the sort. Has a Snezhnayan merchant named Krosl enlisted your ore processing services recently, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: A Snezhnayan merchant named Krosl, you say...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Mm, I do remember that. He brought me a piece of ore, claiming that it was Smaragdus Jadeite.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: That was the first time I'd ever encountered it, so I had no way of telling if it was really Smaragdus Jadeite or not. But if a customer insists, far be it from me to contradict them...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: He was quite generous with his money, too, so I didn't give it too much thought. I processed the ore as per his request.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Hmm... Do you have any leftover debris from your work on it?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Why, yes — it was my first time encountering this ore, after all, so I kept a few loose shavings to study myself later. They're <color=#00E1FFFF>right over there</color>, in fact.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Thank you, Sir. We'll take a look at them.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: Huh? If my eyes don't deceive me, the cross-sections and patterning suggest that these are <color=#00E1FFFF>Smaragdus Nephrite</color> shavings.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Smaragdus Nephrite?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: Yes. It's not particularly rare, nor is it especially valuable. It's used to make jewelry all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: I've heard it said that Smaragdus Nephrite is in fact the outer layer of Smaragdus Jadeite, though no one's ever proven it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A thin layer of separation, huh.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: If you must see for yourself, try examining these shavings for traces of elemental energy. Smaragdus Nephrite is an entirely ordinary ore containing no elemental energy whatsoever.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that so... Well, we might as well give Elemental Sight a shot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, did you find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not a trace of elemental energy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So they really are different! But wait, how come Zhiqiao was able to tell what it was just by looking at the shards? That's pretty awesome.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: There's nothing special to it. It just so happens that I've come across a great many of these in my time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why couldn't Shitou tell them apart?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: These two stones actually look very similar. Someone without a deep understanding of them would find it very difficult to tell them apart.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: There may be only a subtle difference for the casual viewer, but that translates to an astronomical difference in terms of the market price.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: And, I'm sure, a significant difference in the cost of having them carved into shape...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Alright, let's focus up. We're going off on a tangent.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiao
dialogues.text: But... Never mind Shitou — why would Mr. Krosl... huh...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Unusual actions have unusual reasons behind them. Let's take some of these shavings back to Shitou.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Miss Yanfei... Might I be so bold as to inquire... um...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: If you could just confirm for me once more, Sir: Mr. Krosl did indeed claim that the ore he brought to your store was in fact "Smaragdus Jadeite," did he not?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Uh... yes, that's right. I still have a record of the job with me, in fact, um... Here, it says quite clearly: "One chunk Smaragdus Jadeite, uncut."

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Then I have no further questions. But could I borrow the processing record and these stone shavings?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Of course... But might I ask why you need them?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Oh, I have my reasons... Ah, yes, please sign here on this <color=#00E1FFFF>affidavit</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: This document shall serve as signed proof that these stone shavings originated from the, ah, ore that Mr. Krosl brought to your store. Please read it carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Hmm, yes... I see, I see. Forgive me for asking again, Miss Yanfei, but... might I know the nature of the incident on this occasion?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I wouldn't say there's been an "incident" — just a minor issue. Thank you, Sir. I'll take these with me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: With this hard evidence to back us up, Krosl won't dare try to deny what he did!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: On the contrary, this is far from sufficient to build a case. We need to find something a little more... "compelling."

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: If you want to make jewelry, you need a professional jewelsmith. Let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Jewelry... jewelry... hmm, nope...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Aha, got it. <color=#00E1FFFF>Xingxi</color>. She often helps link people up with a jewelsmith. Let's go pay her a visit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that was quick... How come you know so many people?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Because lots of people come to me for legal advice every day.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: As you know, Liyue Harbor is the City of Contracts, and contracts... well, I should say, "laws," are very important to us.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: But the amendments made by the Tianquan to our laws are unnecessarily complicated. How can I put this? It just seems like they're hard to understand and impossible to finish.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: As such, legal advisers like myself provide quite the popular service indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you help them make sense of the law? But didn't you say that it's "hard to understand and impossible to finish"?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Yes, well... That's no obstacle, because I've memorized all the legal codices.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You memorized them!?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: You sound surprised. Knowing the law inside out is a legal adviser's bread and butter, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this how adepti become so adept at everything...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Oh, this has nothing to do with being an adeptus — I just like reading things.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Again with that casual tone...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Well, that's that, then. Let's go look for Xingxi.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Oh, Miss Yanfei, it's you. ...Has something happened? Did the client from last time...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Have no further trouble from then on? Yes, of course. I'm just here to ask you a few questions.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Has a merchant by the name of Krosl asked you to put him in contact with a jewelsmith recently?

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Krosl... Yes, I remember him, he's a merchant from Snezhnaya, no? Yes, he came to me with a chunk of something he called "Smaragdus Jadeite."

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: The design of the hairpins that he gave me was quite intricate, so it took me some work to find someone who was up to the job. Eventually, I found an older jewelsmith who made them exactly according to his specifications.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: This order was on hold for a very long time and only completed quite recently, which is why I remember it so well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Doesn't seem like there's any evidence to be found here...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Ms. Xingxi, I'd like for you to confirm for me once more: When Mr. Krosl commissioned you to find him a jewelsmith, did he or did he not assert that the material he presented to you that day was called "Smaragdus Jadeite"?

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Yes, I'm sure of it. The hairpins were made using many expensive materials and the asking price was quite high, so we had to put this transaction on record with the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Mr. Krosl wasn't very familiar with the necessary procedures, so I filed it on his behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Oh, I also kept <color=#00E1FFFF>a copy for my own records</color>. See for yourself: the item is called "Smaragdus Jadeite Twin-Phoenix Pins."

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: The inlaid gemstone is recorded as Smaragdus Jadeite. The document even has the official seal of the Ministry on it.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Thank you, Xingxi. Now, could you let me borrow this document?

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Sure, it isn't serving much purpose here, anyway. I take it, then, that... there's been some more trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Nothing you need to worry about, just a minor issue. I'll return your document as soon as I'm done with it. Thanks again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why is everyone's first reaction always to assume someone or something is in trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Must be the nature of legal consultancy.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Hmm... I believe we have almost all the evidence we need. We just need to make one last trip — let's go to Bubu Pharmacy to speak with <color=#00E1FFFF>Dr. Baizhu</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...<color=#00E1FFFF>Baizhu</color>?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The weirdo with the snake around his neck? What do you wanna speak to him for?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Because only he can provide an authoritative statement confirming that Smaragdus Jadeite is harmful to the human body.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Once we have this final piece of evidence in our hands, we can wrap this case up.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: My, my, to what do I owe the pleasure? Though I'm afraid that if you're looking for our little Qiqi, she's out gathering herbs.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: And if it isn't Miss Yanfei as well. Now that's an even rarer honor. What business brings you here, might I inquire? Some charlatans peddling ineffectual medicines again, no doubt?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: No, no, I'm here this time to ask if you're familiar with Smaragdus Jadeite.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Smaragdus Jadeite? Why, yes, there is some information about it included in the Sixth Commentary on the "Seven Mountain Treatises."

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: The "Seven Mountain Treatises" states that this substance springs forth from Stonemarrow within the mountains, and will bring disaster to any mere mortals who touch it.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: It is abundant in elemental energy, so if someone without a Vision is in contact with it for a prolonged period... Best case scenario, they fall ill, worst-case scenario, they'll suffer great changes in personality and their illness will only ever get worse...

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Heh... Anyway, I'm sure you didn't come all this way just to chit-chat. Knowing you, Yanfei, and given the specific nature of your question...

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: I suppose that you're about to ask me to write an official affidavit attesting to the pharmaceutical peculiarities of Smaragdus Jadeite?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: That is indeed the case... If you would be so kind, Dr. Baizhu.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: No trouble at all, it's just a single document. Won't take me a moment. I would mention, though, that you're not the only one who's developed a curiosity for Smaragdus Jadeite recently. A Snezhnayan merchant came to ask me about it not long ago.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: But after I gave him my reply, his expression shifted to one of remarkable disappointment...

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: I wonder, Ms. Yanfei, if your pressing business might be related to this Snezhnayan merchant?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Ah, you needn't concern yourself about that, Dr. Baizhu. Thank you for penning us that document, I'll make sure to compensate you in due course.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: You're too kind. Take care, now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That Baizhu guy is as weird as ever.

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: Miss Yanfei, have you finished your investigation? I trust you will now be in a position to assess the compensation due?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Yes, my investigation is indeed concluded. I can now provide a final figure for the amount payable.

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Well then, please, could you do the honors, Miss Yanfei.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Of course. According to the stipulations of the contract...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Mr. Krosl, you must pay Ms. Zhiqiao ten times the original transaction price in Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: Sure— Wait, what!? M—Me, pay her? Surely there's been some kind of mistake, Miss Yanfei?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Not at all. According to my investigations and the material evidence that we've gathered, the substance claimed to be Smaragdus Jadeite that was inlaid within the Smaragdus Jadeite Twin-Phoenix Pins that you rented out to Ms. Zhiqiao was, in fact, Smaragdus Nephrite.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Now, the contract states very clearly that ten times the price shall be paid should the article not be genuine. Accordingly, you are liable for this sum, which is payable to Ms. Zhiqiao in Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: Material evidence? What material evidence? Why, Miss Yanfei, you cannot frame me like this!

dialogues.speaker: Krosl
dialogues.text: ...I spent a huge sum to obtain that Smaragdus Jadeite, and yet you claim that the ore inlaid on the hairpins is somehow fake. I—I demand to see your evidence!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Indeed, only a testimony from an expert witness involved in the processing of the ore can serve as an authoritative assessment of whether it is genuine... Traveler, please produce the evidence in question.

choices.text: Show the evidence from The Jade Mystery.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: This is a processing record from The Jade Mystery, along with stone samples and an affidavit signed by the business owner, Shitou.

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: Seriously...? Even the boss there couldn't differentiate between Smaragdus Jadeite and Smaragdus Nephrite. How does this prove anything?

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: In any case, Smaragdus Nephrite is the outer layer of Smaragdus Jadeite... So I had him cut away the Nephrite, he returned the valuable Jadeite core to me, and some Nephrite samples remain in the store. What am I missing, exactly?

response.speaker: Zhiqiao
response.text: Th—That's an unsubstantiated belief...

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: Well, your claim that my ore is fake is just as unsubstantiated. And we are here to talk about evidence, aren't we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... Looks like our first piece of evidence didn't convince him at all. Seems like he came prepared. What should we do next?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Hard evidence... Something legally binding... We have just the thing. Show him, Traveler.

choices.text: Show the evidence from The Jade Mystery.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Oh, come on, I meant the backup copy of the document from the Ministry of Civil Affairs. The one we got from Xingxi of Mingxing Jewelry.

choices.text: Show the evidence from The Jade Mystery.
Show the evidence from Mingxing Jewelry.

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: Hmph! This document proves that my hairpins are the real deal, doesn't it? This is the Ministry's seal, after all. It shows that the ore inlaid on the pins is indeed Smaragdus Jadeite!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Our second piece of evidence didn't work, either! And this guy's getting more belligerent by the second...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Hmm... You know, you could be right. Perhaps the hairpins are the real deal, after all...

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: Of course I'm right! All the evidence shown supports my story!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Well, hang on a moment, now, because I do recall one final piece of evidence that we haven't revealed yet.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Traveler, would you do the honors? This shall serve as decisive proof of our case.

choices.text: Show the evidence from The Jade Mystery.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I'm referring to the affidavit signed by Dr. Baizhu of Bubu Pharmacy. Now, if you would be so kind as to bring it out, Traveler...

choices.text: Show the evidence from The Jade Mystery.
Show the evidence from Mingxing Jewelry.
Show the evidence from Bubu Pharmacy.

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: Wh—What's this...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: "Smaragdus Jadeite springs forth from Stonemarrow within the mountains, and will bring disaster to any mere mortals who touch it."

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: "Sustained contact with Smaragdus Jadeite over a prolonged period will, in less serious cases, cause a mild malady, while in serious cases, the patient may suffer a dramatic change of personality and fall seriously ill..."

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Mr. Krosl, were you aware of these peculiar properties of Smaragdus Jadeite?

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: I... I had no idea...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: No idea, you say? Hmm... I'd guessed as much. But for you to have rented out such a dangerous item...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I'm afraid that this falls outside the scope of my work, but within that of the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: However, I'm sure that the Ministry will be relatively lenient considering that, as you say, you were ignorant of the danger you posed.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Don't worry, Mr. Krosl. I will make sure that all the evidence presented here will be handed over to the Ministry.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I trust that you'll give them your full cooperation in their investigations.

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: What? Wait, wait! I... I knew...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Oh, so you knew? Oh dear, Mr. Krosl. But if you knew of Smaragdus Jadeite's dangerous properties beforehand, why would you...

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: Huh!? No, er, I... The hairpins aren't actually...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Aren't actually inlaid with genuine Smaragdus Jadeite? Is that what you were about to say?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: You do understand, Mr. Krosl, that this means that you will have to pay Ms. Zhiqiao ten times the original price in Mora?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Mr. Krosl, your answer, please. My client and I are waiting.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yanfei's seriously intimidating right now. It's like she's a different person...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Again, that's legal consultancy for you...

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: I admit it... I confess. The ore I had inlaid on those hairpins was... was Smaragdus Nephrite.

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: ...But I'm a victim in all of this, too! I invested a great deal of time and money into acquiring that small amount of Smaragdus Jadeite in the hopes of turning it into a piece of jewelry that would fetch a fine price...

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: But after receiving it and carrying it around for a few days... I started to feel extreme discomfort. I couldn't sleep a wink, or eat a single bite. I... I was in a constant state of agitation, too...

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: I went to Bubu Pharmacy to get myself checked out, only to discover that this sort of stone cannot be worn as jewelry... But how could I let all that money go to waste?

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: That's why I had another pair of hairpins made from Smaragdus Nephrite, which is almost indistinguishable from Smaragdus Jadeite...

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: I kept the real Smaragdus Jadeite in a specially made box. I daren't touch it again.

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: I was worried that someone would see through it, which is why I only dared to rent them out, not sell them... and then, to top it all off, Zhiqiao lost the hairpins after I rented them out to her...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So why did you charge Zhiqiao such an extortionate rental price?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! If they weren't the real deal, why'd you make her pay so much, hmm?

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: I... I didn't want to, either! But when I purchased that Smaragdus Jadeite, some of my business partners found out. I knew they'd be watching closely to see how much I could make off it.

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: If word got out that I sold a pair of fake hairpins, then... My days in this line of business would be over...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Alright. Let's cut the appeals phase right there. I fail to see what bearing any of this has on your transaction with my client. According to the contract, you must pay Ms. Zhiqiao ten times the original price in Mora, and that is final.

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: Ten... ten times...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Krosl looks like he could faint any second...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: As for me... According to my contract with Ms. Zhiqiao, twenty percent of that sum will go to me.

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: T—Twenty percent!? That's as much as I spent on that Smaragdus Jadeite!

response.speaker: Zhiqiao
response.text: Erm... There's no need. It's fine, you don't have to pay me that much Mora.

response.speaker: Zhiqiao
response.text: Even if the Smaragdus Jadeite on those hairpins was fake, I still bear responsibility for losing them. Legally or not... I think I owe some compensation for that.

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: Ms. Zhiqiao, you...

response.speaker: Zhiqiao
response.text: However, Mr. Krosl, since you have no use for that chunk of Smaragdus Jadeite, why don't you give it to me instead? I'll consider us even.

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: What? But... I... Alright then. This cursed rock's brought me enough grief as it is...

response.speaker: Zhiqiao
response.text: Miss Yanfei, I'll turn this Smaragdus Jadeite over to you. I trust that it will suffice as remuneration?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Well, um, that's not quite how the rules say this should go... but whatever. It'll do.

response.speaker: Zhiqiao
response.text: Thanks so much for your help this time, Miss Yanfei. When you have the time, I'll be sure to visit and express my thanks more appropriately.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Oh, come on, no need to stand on ceremony. Now, if I may confirm this again, Ms. Zhiqiao, have you and Mr. Krosl come to an understanding?

response.speaker: Zhiqiao
response.text: Mm? Well, yes, I believe we have.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Well then, that's good. Mr. Krosl, it seems that my client has no further claims against you.

response.speaker: Krosl
response.text: Is... Is that so... That's good, that's good...

response.speaker: Zhiqiao
response.text: Actually... Mr. Krosl... I'd like to talk business for a second, if I may.

response.speaker: Zhiqiao
response.text: I could see from the hairpins you produced that you're very skilled in jewelry design. My family, on the other hand, works in the ore business, and we have a fair stock of fine ores...

choices.text: Show the evidence from Mingxing Jewelry.
Show the evidence from Bubu Pharmacy.
Show the evidence from Bubu Pharmacy.
Show the evidence from Mingxing Jewelry.

Show the evidence from Mingxing Jewelry.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Ahem... If we want to determine whether the ore is genuine, we need to start with evidence from The Jade Mystery. Clearly, you still have a few things to learn about this aspect of legal proceedings...

Show the evidence from Mingxing Jewelry.

Show the evidence from Bubu Pharmacy.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Ah, you've returned. How did it go? Were you able to find the Smaragdus Jadeite?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We were, thanks to Yanfei.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Good, good. Then we have all the materials we need.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Well, if we're all set, Granny, I'll get going now. Got a ton of clients waiting for me back at the office.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Oh, you... alright then, go see to your business. Granny should be able to handle the rest.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I'm off then, bye! Oh yes, Traveler, make sure you don't lose the business card I gave you.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I've been looking into the laws of other nations as well. If you should ever bump into any trouble with the law, come find me directly. Regulars get discounts too!

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Come now, child, are you leaving or are you not? If you have no wish to leave, perhaps you'd like to help me clean my teapot, mm?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I'm leaving, I'm leeeeaving!

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...That child, goodness knows where she learned to be so rambunctious. Her father was hardly so riotous or fond of talking nonsense back in the day when he stood beside Rex Lapis.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A truly unique adeptus...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Indeed she is... Liyue has changed, and the adepti must also learn to change.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Yanfei might be overly garrulous, but she is also the most intimately acquainted with the city among us all.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: *sigh* Liyue is not the same place I once knew...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Granny...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Alright then, let us speak of this no more. Back on topic, I believe that I still owe you a little gift.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! Paimon's so excited! How is it made?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And how long does it take...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Haha, it is but a single teapot. It shan't take long at all. Just wait here for a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Hoo, there we go. This <color=#00E1FFFF>Serenitea Pot</color> is all yours now.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Hold it firmly — if you were to drop it... Ho ho, goodness! Who knows what might happen?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Take these blueprints with you as well. You'll need them if you wish to make your teapot a little more lively inside.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks, Granny.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a minute... Granny, how exactly are we supposed to use this teapot?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Oh, you needn't worry about that. I've already arranged for a certain <color=#00E1FFFF>little helper</color> to await you within this teapot. She will explain everything you need to know about it.
